summary: SLICKHAIR is a Melbourne hair-styling brand founded by Mia Plecic, now described as an 8-figure global brand in thousands of stores with four warehouses. Amy Fox joined in 2026 as Global Financial Controller to lead finance through international growth, and Mia announced in Nov 2025 she is exploring private equity investment for the US. Amy's only email on file is a Goldi Group address, the firm she left in June 2026.

claims.text: SLICKHAIR is headquartered in Melbourne, Victoria.
Amy Fox announced in July 2026 she joined SLICKHAIR as Global Financial Controller, leading finance through huge international growth.
claims.quote: I’ve joined the team as Global Financial Controller, leading the finance function through a period of huge international growth

claims.text: In the same post Amy said her time at Goldi Group has come to an end.
claims.quote: my time at Goldi Group has come to an end

claims.text: Founder Mia Plecic posted in Nov 2025 that she is exploring private equity investment to scale SLICKHAIR in the US market.
claims.quote: I’m officially exploring private equity investment to help scale SLICKHAIR deeper into the US market

claims.text: Mia describes SLICKHAIR as a profitable 8-figure global brand.
claims.quote: scaling it into a strong 8-figure global brand, and remaining profitable from day one

claims.text: Mia's Dec 2024 post says SLICKHAIR is stocked in more than 4,000 stores in over 10 countries with 4 warehouses across the world.
claims.quote: stocked in more than 4,000 stores in over 10 countries, we have 4 warehouses across the world

claims.text: news.com.au (Sep 2025) reports SLICKHAIR stocked in over 5,000 retail stores including Woolworths, Priceline, Sephora and Urban Outfitters.
claims.quote: Slick Hair is now stocked in over 5,000 retail stores worldwide, including Woolworths, Priceline, Sephora, and Urban Outfitters.

claims.text: On a Feb 2025 podcast Mia said she is a creative, not a financier person.
claims.quote: I’m very much a creative, not a financier person

claims.text: On the same podcast Mia said a very big goal was landing a big box retailer in the States.
claims.quote: a very big goal this year to land a big box retailer in the States

hooks.text: New Global FC leading finance through international growth: window to set up the close process.
PE exploration means diligence-ready, auditable books will matter.
Multi-country footprint with several warehouses and big retailers implies heavy reconciliation load; founder admits finance is not her strength so Amy owns it.

risks.text: Amy's only email on file is her Goldi Group address, and she says she left Goldi in 2026: the address may be stale or monitored by Goldi; verify before sending.
Heli Vyas (finance manager) has no email on file.

gaps: Official slickhair.com pages not fetched; no finance-specific posts by Amy found after her announcement; tech stack (Shopify/Xero) only from the account record, not cited.
